projects.name: Financial Tracker
projects.description: Self-hosted personal finance app with JWT auth and full per-user data isolation. Manage accounts, transactions, and categories with a real-time dashboard, income vs. expense charts, search, pagination, and dark/light theming. Backed by a pytest suite with 28+ tests and CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

projects.name: My Book List
projects.description: MAL-inspired personal book catalog with user accounts, JWT auth, and personalized reading lists. Track books as Reading, Completed, Plan to Read, or Dropped — with ratings and reviews. Searches millions of titles via the Open Library API. Built with Spring Boot (Java) backend and a React + TypeScript frontend, deployed to Fly.io via GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.name: OHS Remote
projects.description: Capstone safety compliance platform that generates professional, branded OHS manuals for businesses. REST APIs handle order management, company branding (logo upload), NAICS-based industry classification, and secure token-based document downloads. AI-powered document generation uses OpenAI with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to produce industry-specific Safety Job Procedures (SJPs) and Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) tailored to jurisdiction and NAICS codes. Includes Swagger docs, Alembic migrations, and email delivery.
